## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side at D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`), n = +1.0 → +3.2×10¹², B 0.3 → 8 T

> **05:27** · landau-fan-vti electron D=0: n +3.2 -> +1.0e12 (51 cols, dn 0.044), B 0.3 -> 8 T ascending, 160 rows uniform-1/B (101 to 1.2 T @0.025/T, 60 to 8 T @0.0121/T), sr1 100 uV, fast\_delay 1.2 s, slow\_delay 1 s; ends at 8 T, gates parked 0 · **ETA ~10:17** (≈4h50m)

**Why this fan, from the spot checks (read from disk, `sdh_onset` + `sdh_fft`; ana cell to follow):** run 6 (electron, n = +3.2×10¹², F_L = 33.1 T) carries a dominant **7.1 T tone = 0.215·F_L** with a 2×/3×/4× harmonic comb, still above threshold at the record's low edge (**censored onset at 0.3 T**) — a very light, high-mobility pocket (model ABAB light pocket at this n: 7.3 T, m* ≈ 0.027). Above ~3 T the spectrum hands over to a **~30–33 T tone (≈ F_L)** with QH-like minima (R → 0 at 6.0 and 7.2 T) — the sum-tone / breakdown / total-density confound the investigation makes mandatory to discriminate. Run 7 (hole, n = −1.2×10¹², F_L = 12.4 T) shows 6.6 / 4.7 / 8.5 / 12.3 T — the near-CNP balanced-pair regime where the model's 5.9 / 6.5 T pair merges inside δF = 0.77 T. **The electron side is the cleaner side** — the fan goes there. **Coverage trade:** the hole side of the D = 0 line reaches only n = −1.28×10¹² inside the validators (the recipe's low-|n| exception regime); it is covered by run 7 at one density and excluded here — a hole fan would cost ~3 h for a regime the recipe says cannot separate the templates.

**What the fan buys:** F(n) trajectories over n = 1.0 → 3.2×10¹² (Δn = 0.044, 51 columns) for (i) the light tone — ABAB predicts a *curved* branch emptying near n ≈ 0.8 (0.6 T at 1.0, 2.0 at 1.5, 3.6 at 2.0, 5.1 at 2.5, 7.3 at 3.2), a trilayer ML pocket a lower fraction on its own curve, ABCB a supra-linear Dirac partner; (ii) the ≈F_L tone's origin via the B-window split per column; (iii) the Luttinger sum across density. Top column = run 6's density, so acquisition quality is compared at a shared density.

**Grid (computed, not eyeballed):** slow axis uniform in 1/B, piecewise: **[0.3, 1.2] T at Δ(1/B) = 0.025 T⁻¹ (101 rows)** — run 6 shows nothing faster than the 7.1 T tone and its 14 T harmonic (SNR < 10) below 1.2 T; the 22 / 29.5 T harmonics and the F_L-scale tone all onset at ≥ 1.36 T — so 20 T Nyquist there; **[1.2, 8.0] T at Δ(1/B) = 1/(2.5·F_L(3.2)) = 0.0121 T⁻¹ (60 rows)** — Nyquist ×1.25 on the fastest expected tone at the highest n. 160 rows total. B_lo = 0.3 T = the censored onset's record edge (a valid lower bound; a light tone with F = 2 T still gets ≥ 5 periods, i.e. resolved down to n ≈ 1.4; below that the light branch is a low-field-cut job, not a fan job). B_max = 8 T: the heavy-vs-F_L split needs δF ≲ 2.5 T from a ~1.6 T heavy-tone onset (8 T gives 2.0 T); rows above 8 T are nearly free in count but cost bare ramp. n-axis: 51 points = ray-Nyquist (≥ 2 pts/ray) for B ≥ 0.9 T; the FFT read needs far less (light-tone slope ≈ 0.15 T/column ≪ δF = 0.31 T). **Dynamic range:** worst corner is n = 1.0 × high B — run 5's D = 0 anchor there is 117 Ω, and run 6 showed a ×10 MR hump (52 → 530 Ω at 8.7 T) even at n = 3.2 → ~1.2 kΩ expected, so **sr1 at 100 µV = 10 kΩ FS** (8× headroom; the run-4 rail is the lesson — saturation is unrecoverable, resolution loss is not; light-tone amplitudes are 10–100 Ω). Dwell: `fast_delay = 1.2 s` = 4τ (τ = 0.3 s, 24 dB) — the extracted signal runs along B, which is settled row-to-row by the magnet's 3 s driver settle; `slow_delay = 1 s`.

**Price:** 160 rows × (51 × 1.45 s/pt + ~6 s settle/flyback/slow_delay) ≈ 3.6 h + 7.7 T bare ramp 56 min ≈ 4.5 h; +8 % over the bracket per this rig's record → ~4h50m. Calibration: run 5 megasweep at fast_delay 1.0 → 0.99 s/pt net of turnaround; the VTI variant's 1.44 s/pt at 4τ. Ends at **8 T with gates parked at 0** — the LK mass split / next segment rides the magnet down.

**Preconditions (read, not set):** T_sample 1.0–1.5 K, |B| < 0.05 T (magnet at 0 after the handoff; the sweep positions to 0.3 T itself), V_si = 0, PS heater on / output enabled, gate NPLC 1/1, thermometry logfile live. **Checkpoints:** (1) first 3 rows (~5 min after positioning): R inside FS, both gate columns moving as a pair, |I_gate| < 200 pA beyond the flyback transient, T at base — abort on a rail or leak; (2) ~row 101 (end of the low-B segment, ≈ 2.3 h): interim per-column FFT of the landed 0.3–1.2 T record — is the light tone's F(n) a single Onsager trajectory? continue / adjust; (3) completion → ana (raw grids first, then per-column FFT, dual overlay, Luttinger sum).

# === Landau fan, electron side at D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`): n = +1.0 -> +3.2e12 (51 cols), B 0.3 -> 8 T (160 rows, uniform 1/B piecewise) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
D0 = 0.0
ns = np.linspace(3.2, 1.0, 51)                  # 1e12 cm^-2, fast axis, high -> low n (dn = 0.044)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, D0 * np.ones_like(ns), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
Vtgs, Vbgs = np.asarray(Vtgs), np.asarray(Vbgs)
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vtgs.min(), Vtgs.max(), Vbgs.min(), Vbgs.max())
assert len(Vtgs) == len(Vbgs) == len(ns)
print(f"fast axis: n = {ns[0]:+.2f} -> {ns[-1]:+.2f} e12 ({len(ns)} pts, dn = {abs(ns[1]-ns[0]):.3f}), D = {D0:+.2f} V/nm; "
      f"Vtg {Vtgs.min():+.4f}..{Vtgs.max():+.4f} V, Vbg {Vbgs.min():+.4f}..{Vbgs.max():+.4f} V; "
      f"roundtrip top/bottom n,D = {calc_nD(Vtgs[0], Vbgs[0], **CAL)}, {calc_nD(Vtgs[-1], Vbgs[-1], **CAL)}")

# --- slow axis: uniform in 1/B, piecewise (run-6 evidence: only the 7.1 T tone + its 14 T harmonic below 1.2 T; F_L-scale tones onset >= 1.36 T) ---
F_L_TOP = cst.h / (4 * cst.e) * ns.max() * 1e16          # Luttinger frequency at the top density, T
d_low, d_dense = 0.025, 1.0 / (2.5 * F_L_TOP)            # T^-1: 20 T Nyquist below 1.2 T; 1.25x Nyquist on F_L above
B_a = field_invB(0.3, 1.2, int(np.ceil((1 / 0.3 - 1 / 1.2) / d_low)) + 1)
B_b = field_invB(1.2, 8.0, int(np.ceil((1 / 1.2 - 1 / 8.0) / d_dense)) + 1)
B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.hstack((B_a, B_b)), 4))    # ascending, 0.3 -> 8.0 T
assert B_vec.min() > 0 and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0)
print(f"slow axis: {len(B_vec)} rows, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T ({len(B_a)} rows to 1.2 T at d(1/B) = {d_low}, "
      f"{len(B_b)} rows 1.2 -> 8 T at d(1/B) = {d_dense:.4f}; F_L(top) = {F_L_TOP:.1f} T); max dB {np.diff(B_vec).max():.3f} T")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan positions to 0.3 T), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not 1"

FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.2, 1.0    # 4 tau at tau = 0.3 s / 24 dB; slow_delay on top of the driver's 3 s field settle
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan (no autorange): 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA — worst corner n = 1.0 x high B (~1.2 kOhm expected).
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> 10 nA; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (10 kOhm FS), tau {sr1.time_constant()} s, slope {sr1.filter_slope()} dB; "
      f"sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V; fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan electron D = 0: n = {ns[0]:+.2f} -> {ns[-1]:+.2f} e12 ({len(ns)} cols), B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T "
                  f"({len(B_vec)} rows, uniform 1/B piecewise), run-5 cal, sr1 100 uV, fast_delay {FAST_DELAY}")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'D = {D0:+.2f} V/nm, n = {ns[-1]:+.2f} to {ns[0]:+.2f} e12 cm^-2 ({len(ns)} pts, fast high->low), '
              f'B = {B_vec[0]} to {B_vec[-1]} T ({len(B_vec)} rows: {len(B_a)} uniform-1/B to 1.2 T d(1/B)={d_low}, {len(B_b)} uniform-1/B to 8 T d(1/B)={d_dense:.4f}); '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; '
              f'sr1 100 uV, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s, fast_delay {FAST_DELAY}, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY}; follows sdh-spot-check runs 6/7')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg, Vbg (fast pair), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.3f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs], slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)   # park gates; field stays where the fan ended (8 T) for the next segment
    print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")
